standard.selection: Explicitly selected by the project owner on 2026-10-02. Corporate publication is not asserted.
standard.snapshot_policy: Byte-identical review snapshot of the owner-selected source; do not edit manually or treat illustrative examples as exception approvals.

interpretation.rule_status: declared means present in the selected source, not implemented, compliant or approved as an exception.
interpretation.source_ranges: Groups end before the next group or top-level section; individual definitions are exact declaration lines and retain parent-group precedence. Unnumbered context is interpreted from the selected source; ranges do not grant waiver scope.
interpretation.enforcement: required_enforcement values are obligations to implement or review, not claims that named gates/tests exist. adoption.evidence records inspected source/configuration or retained local output; no whole-group PASS is inferred from one green subgate.
interpretation.exceptions: Adoption verdicts are not independent approvals. Only explicit named clause keys or exact normative sentences may identify a future narrow waiver; no registry record is created here.

rules.title: repositories **MUST** contain a root `global.json`. Its version **MUST** be advanced as part of routine dependency/platform maintenance.

rules.title: stable branches **MUST NOT** use `allowPrerelease: true`, `rollForward: latestMajor`, or an equivalent mechanism that can silently advance the compiler/runtime generation.

adoption.next_action: Preserve these settings when the approved servicing version changes.
